name: codex-quota-capsule-windows
description: Windows Quota Capsule: Codex weekly runway gauge

scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/core && npm run sync && npm run build -w packages/source-codex && npm run build -w packages/source-cursor
scripts.lint: tsc -p packages/core/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p packages/source-codex/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p packages/source-cursor/tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.win:build: npm run build && npm run stage:bridge && npm run tauri -w quota-capsule-windows -- build && npm run copy:portable
